thought.text: Several long-running services exited because first-run migrations exceeded the readiness probe. Migrations are now applied. Let me restart all the servers that should be running.

reasoning_content:
Several processes fail readiness probe because migrations take longer than the 20-second initial delay. Those that completed on the first attempt (agent-orchestration, comment, document-management) actually started successfully but got shut down because readiness probe failed during migrations. Now migrations are complete for those, so restarting them should make them healthy. But process-compose marks "Completed" and won't necessarily re-run. Let me restart them.

Also, formal-completeness now Running - good. plausibility-notes Running - good. project-logic Running. administrative-file-draft Running.

frontend still Skipped. Let me look at why - it seems it needs to run. Let me restart the ones that are Completed but should be running: document-management, comment, agent-orchestration, examination, objections-management, identity-management, protocol, gesetzesbegruendung-db, jura-db, rechtsaenderungs-monitoring, temporal-job.

Actually let me check the full list of expected long-running services. Many "Completed" are services that should be Running (like identity-management, protocol, examination). temporal-job, temporal-codec should run. gesetzesbegruendung-db, jura-db, rechtsaenderungs-monitoring are DB services that should run.

Let me look at which are meant to be long-running (uvicorn) vs one-shot seeds. The seed ones end with "-seed". The rest are servers.

So need to restart: agent-orchestration, comment, document-management, examination, gesetzesbegruendung-db, identity-management, jura-db, objections-management, protocol, rechtsaenderungs-monitoring, temporal-job.

Also frontend. Let me restart them all.

Wait, but process-compose "Completed" with exit 0 - a restart should rerun. Let me restart them.

Also concern: some may have genuinely completed because they're short-lived? No—these are uvicorn servers. They should be Running. The ones that are Completed fail because the readiness check killed them during migration.

Let me restart all the non-running servers and the frontend.

Let me also verify the frontend issue—maybe pnpm not on PATH within process-compose environment. Let me check.

action.command: cd /workspace && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH" && for p in agent-orchestration comment document-management examination gesetzesbegruendung-db identity-management jura-db objections-management protocol rechtsaenderungs-monitoring temporal-job temporal-codec frontend; do process-compose process restart "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "restarted $p" || echo "FAILED $p"; done
